lines.en: label kaoridate15p3:
scene nightsky
It’s funny how you can gradually drift from one place to somewhere on the complete opposite side of the world town without ever realizing it until it’s time to go home.
lines.zh: 有趣的是，你能够从一个地方一点点漂到这座小镇完全相反的另一头，却直到该回家的时候才意识到。

lines.en: Well, I suppose that “funny” isn’t the right word to describe that phenomenon.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想「有趣」并不是形容这种现象的恰当用词。

lines.en: And I suppose that “phenomenon” isn’t the right word to describe the act of simply walking.
lines.zh: 而且我想，「现象」也不是形容单纯走路这个行为的恰当用词。

lines.en: But let’s say for a moment that neither Kaori nor myself walked anywhere and only happened upon places like the chicken alley and the maid cafe by wishing ourselves there.
lines.zh: 不过我们暂且假设，Kaori 和我哪儿都没走，只是靠许愿把自己送到了鸡巷和女仆咖啡厅这样的地方。

lines.en: If I could, I’d like to wish myself back home to avoid having to deal with the now miles we must traverse on account of Kaori not wanting to ride a bus.
lines.zh: 如果可以的话，我想许愿让自己直接回到家，省得因为 Kaori 不想坐公交，而不得不走这好几英里的路。

lines.en: Or, as she referred to it- a motorized wheely mega-car.
lines.zh: 或者，按她的说法——机动轮子巨型车。

lines.en: Regardless, our journey begins at a time when everything has already quieted down, leaving myself and one of many surprisingly loud girls I know to find things to converse about.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们的这段路程开始于一切都已经安静下来的时候，于是就只剩下我、和我认识的众多吵得出奇的女孩中的一位，去找点能聊的东西。

lines.en: We talk about animals and machinery and the prospect of mechanized animals that you don’t have to feed.
lines.zh: 我们聊动物，聊机械，还聊那种不用喂食的机械动物的可能性。

lines.en: Pets who would go on to live forever, completely avoiding the sometimes immediate need to console others as they come face to face with death when they least expect it.
lines.zh: 那样的宠物可以永远活下去，也就完全不必在某个最猝不及防的时刻，急着去安慰那些直面死亡的人。

lines.en: These strange, fictional creatures we come up with sound quite nice.
lines.zh: 我们想出来的这些奇怪的、虚构的生物，听起来相当不错。

lines.en: And it ultimately leads me to the idea of a world in which I could just replace everyone and everything with a mechanized version.
lines.zh: 而这最终让我想到了这样一个世界：我可以把所有人和所有东西都换成机械版本。

lines.en: That way, I’d never have to worry about doing something that breaks them.
lines.zh: 那样的话，我就永远不必担心自己做了什么会弄坏它们。

lines.en: Because I could always take them to a repair shop or something along those lines if they wound up going haywire.
lines.zh: 因为万一它们失控了，我总能把它们送到修理铺之类的地方去。

lines.en: Or, if I read the control manual really hard and paid close attention to how the machines operated, I could learn how to shut them off and do as I pleased with them whenever I wanted.
lines.zh: 或者，只要我拼命研读操控手册、仔细留意机器的运作方式，我就能学会怎么把它们关掉，然后想对它们做什么就做什么。

lines.en: This is not a specific thing that Kaori and I talk about, but one of many things that pop into my mind as we round corner after corner, likely getting lost along the way.
lines.zh: 这倒不是我和 Kaori 具体聊到的话题，而是我们拐过一个又一个街角、大概还迷了路的时候，我脑子里冒出来的众多念头之一。

lines.en: Neither of us have any idea where we’re going.
lines.zh: 我们俩都不知道自己在往哪儿走。

lines.en: Kaori says she does, but she’s also the same girl who refers to hands as “arm feet” and chickens as “friends.”
lines.zh: Kaori 说她知道，可她也是那个把手叫「胳膊脚」、把鸡叫「朋友」的女孩。

lines.en: She’s just as broken as I am.
lines.zh: 她和我一样，都是坏掉的。

lines.en: But what isn’t broken around here?
lines.zh: 可这附近，又有什么不是坏掉的呢？

lines.en: I feel what I think at first to be a raindrop land on my head, only to realize seconds after that it was melted snow disembarking from the gutter of a closed fish market.
lines.zh: 我感到有什么东西落在头上，一开始以为是雨滴，几秒之后才意识到，那是从一家已经关门的水产店屋檐水槽上落下来的融雪。

lines.en: I run my hand through my hair and bid goodbye to the droplet as it attempts to rejoin the water cycle.
lines.zh: 我用手拢了拢头发，向那滴水珠道别，看它试图重新回到水循环里去。

lines.en: And then a strange girl begins to say more strange things.
lines.zh: 然后，一个奇怪的女孩开始说出更多奇怪的话。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney1
: Friend! Now that the sun has fallen asleep, we can begin to ask each other more interesting questions!
lines.zh: : 朋友！既然太阳已经睡着了，我们可以开始互相问一些更有趣的问题了！

lines.en: : Like what colors we think whales are or how far we think we could throw a leg-hand-ball!
lines.zh: : 比如我们觉得鲸鱼是什么颜色的，或者我们觉得自己能把一个腿手球扔多远！

lines.en: : Football. And are those really your ideas of “more interesting questions?”
lines.zh: : 那是橄榄球。还有，这些真的就是你心目中「更有趣的问题」吗？

lines.en: : I want to know everything there is to know about you! I am just choosing the most interesting topics first.
lines.zh: : 我想知道关于你的一切！我只是先挑最有趣的话题来问。

lines.en: : Why not choose something we’d be able to keep talking about after I answer?
lines.zh: : 为什么不挑一个在我回答之后我们还能继续聊下去的话题呢？

lines.en: : Hmm...
: Okay!
: Describe to me your ideal world!
lines.zh: : 向我描述一下你理想中的世界！

lines.en: scene kaorijourney2
: Huh. That’s actually a pretty good one. Why not ask things like that more often?
lines.zh: : 嚯。这个其实相当不错。为什么不多问点这种问题呢？

lines.en: : Long conversations make the skin flaps that cover my eyes feel heavy and, before long, I have to open my mouth really wide to lighten them.
lines.zh: : 太长的对话会让盖住我眼睛的皮肤片变重，用不了多久，我就得把嘴张得特别大，好让它们轻一点。

lines.en: : It is a strange process that I do not yet understand, but is almost always almost successful!
lines.zh: : 这是个我还没搞懂的奇怪过程，不过它几乎总是几乎能成功！

lines.en: : Almost always almost successful?
lines.zh: : 几乎总是几乎成功？

lines.en: : It works occasionally.
lines.zh: : 偶尔管用。

lines.en: : Now, please proceed to tell me about the things you would do to this world if only you could.
lines.zh: : 那么，请接着告诉我，如果你能办到，你会对这个世界做些什么。

lines.en: I think about whether or not I should come clean about my newfound desire to replace everyone with machines and then decide against it because-
lines.zh: 我琢磨着，要不要把自己新冒出来的、想把所有人都换成机器的念头坦白出来，最后还是决定不说，因为——

lines.en: In a sense, breaking can be beautiful too.
lines.zh: 从某种意义上说，坏掉也可以是很美的。

lines.en: It doesn’t make me happy to see people in bad conditions, but it does make everything around me feel kind of like Kaori’s eye flaps after she opens her mouth really wide.
lines.zh: 看到别人处境糟糕，我并不会开心，但这确实让我周围的一切，感觉有点像 Kaori 把嘴张得很大之后的那对眼皮。

lines.en: It all gets lighter.
lines.zh: 一切都变轻了。

lines.en: Everything stops falling and floats instead.
lines.zh: 一切都停止下坠，转而上浮。

lines.en: And so I decide to speak from the heart about the world I would create if only I could.
lines.zh: 于是我决定，发自内心地讲一讲那个如果我能创造、就会创造出来的世界。

lines.en: : I think the world we live in now is fine.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们现在生活的这个世界就挺好。

lines.en: : Miserable, but fine.
lines.zh: : 很悲惨，但挺好。

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, I think a world without misery would be even more miserable. So I’m perfectly content with where we are now.
lines.zh: : 说来奇怪，我觉得一个没有悲惨的世界，反而会更加悲惨。所以我对我们现在的处境非常满意。

lines.en: : There is nothing at all you would change?
lines.zh: : 你完全没有什么想改变的吗？

lines.en: : You would not turn the clouds into candy or put a smile on the sun?
lines.zh: : 你不会把云变成糖，也不会给太阳画上一张笑脸？

lines.en: : Those are just visual changes. They wouldn’t really affect our day-to-day lives in any way.
lines.zh: : 那只是视觉上的变化而已。它们并不会真的以任何方式影响我们的日常生活。

lines.en: : Raining candy would affect my daily life in many ways!
lines.zh: : 下糖果雨会在很多方面影响我的日常生活！

lines.en: : My teeth would become very bad and it would eventually become much harder to grind up food with them.
lines.zh: : 我的牙齿会变得很糟糕，最后用它们磨碎食物会困难得多。

lines.en: : Either way, I don’t really know what else I would change.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我真不知道自己还想改变什么。

lines.en: Besides the machine thing, but I’ve already decided against telling her that.
lines.zh: 除了把人都换成机器那件事，不过我已经决定不告诉她了。

lines.en: scene happy9
scene kaorijourney3
: Liar.
lines.zh: : 骗子。

lines.en: : ...I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: scene kaorijourney4
: There are many things you would change.
lines.zh: : 你想改变的东西有很多。

lines.en: : I know this for sure because you never smile.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，因为你从来不笑。

lines.en: : Who would want to live on a giant floating ball where they are incapable of contorting their facial muscles into the most important look there is?
lines.zh: : 谁会愿意住在一颗巨大的漂浮球体上，却没办法把自己的面部肌肉拧成那个最重要的表情呢？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : Someone who’s already given up, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概是某个已经放弃的人吧。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney5
: Never give up, Friendburger Man!
lines.zh: : 永远不要放弃，朋友堡人！

lines.en: : If this world can not make you smile, all you have to do is create a new one!
lines.zh: : 如果这个世界没法让你笑出来，那你只要创造一个新的就行了！

lines.en: : Put a bunch of your favorite things into a box and shake it really hard!
lines.zh: : 把你最喜欢的一堆东西装进一个盒子里，然后使劲摇一摇！

lines.en: : What comes out will probably be really small because your arm feet can’t hold a box as big as the world.
lines.zh: : 摇出来的东西大概会非常小，因为你的胳膊脚举不动一个和世界一样大的盒子。

lines.en: : But if you close your eyes, you can pretend to jump into it and then smile once you get there!
lines.zh: : 不过只要你闭上眼睛，就可以假装跳进去，等你到了里面再笑出来！

lines.en: : Every day is special. But the days where your facial muscles are working properly are even more special than that.
lines.zh: : 每一天都很特别。不过你的面部肌肉正常运转的那些日子，比这还要特别。

lines.en: : Your positivity can be really overwhelming at times, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 你的乐观有时候真的让人招架不住，Kaori。

lines.en: : Does it make you sad?
lines.zh: : 这会让你难过吗？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太会。

lines.en: : You appear to have caught the sadness.
lines.zh: : 你看起来好像染上悲伤了。

lines.en: : I have not “caught the sadness.”
lines.zh: : 我没有「染上悲伤」。

lines.en: : It must have possessed you when it left my body in the maid realm.
lines.zh: : 它一定是在女仆国度里离开我身体的时候，附到你身上去了。

lines.en: : It’ll come back. There’s plenty more misery to be experienced in your life, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 它会回来的。我敢肯定，你的人生里还有大把的苦难等着你去体验。

lines.en: : The raspberry child told me the secret to expelling it, so everything will be kay-okay from now on.
lines.zh: : 那个树莓孩子告诉了我驱赶它的秘诀，所以从今往后，一切都会好——好的。

lines.en: : A-Okay. And sure, if that’s what you want to believe, go ahead and believe it.
lines.zh: : A-Okay。当然了，如果你愿意这么相信，那就尽管相信吧。

lines.en: : I’ll probably wind up being there when things get bad again, so I’ll do whatever it is I can to help as long as it’s not a major inconvenience.
lines.zh: : 等事情再变糟的时候，我大概还是会在你身边，所以只要不是太麻烦，我会尽我所能去帮你。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney6
: I hereby name you...Sadburger Friend Man!
lines.zh: : 我在此为你命名……伤心堡朋友人！

lines.en: : I feel like I’ve doubled my nickname count today.
lines.zh: : 我感觉我今天的外号数量翻了一倍。

lines.en: : You are a very sad burger.
lines.zh: : 你是一个非常伤心的汉堡。

lines.en: : But since you attempted to give happiness back to me, I will now share some of it with you!
lines.zh: : 不过既然你试着把快乐还给了我，那我现在也要分一些给你！

lines.en: scene kaorijourney7
: Would you like to see my apartment, Friend-Sad-Man-Burger-Chan?
lines.zh: : 你想看看我的公寓吗，朋友-伤心-人-堡-chan？

lines.en: : I have heard that human males get very excited when they enter the domain of the opposite sex.
lines.zh: : 我听说，人类男性进入异性的领地时，会非常兴奋。

lines.en: : I mean...I’m fine with that. But are you sure you are?
lines.zh: : 我是说……我没问题。不过你确定吗？

lines.en: : Yes! I have already informed you that John misses you! And he will be very excited to have company!
lines.zh: : 当然！我已经告诉过你了，John 想你！有伴儿陪它，它会非常兴奋的！

lines.en: : The cock will perk right up!
lines.zh: : 那只 cock 会立刻精神起来的！

lines.en: : It already kind of is.
lines.zh: : 它其实已经有点精神了。

lines.en: : Then the things I heard were true! Isn’t that excellent?
lines.zh: : 那我听到的事果然是真的！这难道不棒极了吗？

lines.en: Kaori...really does make it difficult to wallow in self-pity when she’s around.
lines.zh: 有 Kaori 在身边……真的很难让人沉溺在自怜里。

lines.en: Not that what I was feeling is self-pity or anything.
lines.zh: 倒不是说我刚才的那种感受就是自怜什么的。

lines.en: I’d probably call it something more like a melancholic longing or a...resigned exhaustion.
lines.zh: 我大概会把它叫做某种忧郁的渴望，或者……认命的疲惫。

lines.en: Some combination of words I’m sure she wouldn’t be able to grasp considering that it wasn’t until today that she really came to terms with how dark this place can be at times.
lines.zh: 这种词的组合她肯定理解不了，毕竟直到今天，她才真正接受了这个世界有时候能有多黑暗。

lines.en: scene happy9
scene kaorijourney3
: You should stop thinking so much.
lines.zh: : 你不该想这么多。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney7
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : It’s no fun carrying on a talk-marathon by myself and your brain keeps going BZZZ BZZZ from the sadness cloud inside of it.
lines.zh: : 我一个人跑这场说话马拉松一点也不好玩，而且你的脑子因为里面那朵悲伤云，一直在 BZZZ BZZZ 地响。

lines.en: : The cloud normally hangs over a person’s head, not inside of it.
lines.zh: : 云一般是悬在人的头顶上，不是在人的脑袋里的。

lines.en: : The sky is naked tonight and there are no clouds anywhere! So you must have eaten them!
lines.zh: : 今晚的天空是光着的，哪儿都没有云！所以一定是你把它们吃掉了！

lines.en: : We have to be getting close to your place by now, right?
lines.zh: : 我们现在总该快到你家了吧？

lines.en: : Are your lower arm tubes also tired from all the stepping?
lines.zh: : 你的下臂管也因为走了这么多路而累了吗？

lines.en: : No, it’s just getting a little hard to keep up with a conversation that is half about my ideal world and half about noises inside of my brain.
lines.zh: : 不是，只是这场一半在聊我的理想世界、一半在聊我脑子里噪音的对话，越来越难跟上了。

lines.en: : Then wish for a world where there are no noises in your brain!
lines.zh: : 那就许愿要一个脑子里没有噪音的世界！

lines.en: : That’s not really the problem here.
lines.zh: : 问题其实不在这儿。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney8
: Then what is, Friend?
lines.zh: : 那问题在哪儿，朋友？

lines.en: : How can I make the clouds disappear?
lines.zh: : 我要怎样才能让那些云消失？

lines.en: : Ask and it shall be given.
lines.zh: : 祈求，就必被赐予。

lines.en: : All I ask is that I don’t randomly wake up somewhere else one day and have to start over.
lines.zh: : 我唯一祈求的，就是别哪天莫名其妙在别的地方醒来，然后一切重来。

lines.en: : You can ask for more, Friend.
lines.zh: : 你可以祈求更多，朋友。

lines.en: : I’m selfish enough as is.
lines.zh: : 我已经够自私了。

lines.en: : If you are selfish, why did you tell me knock knock poems and buy me a chicken sandwich?
lines.zh: : 如果你自私，那为什么你要给我讲敲敲门诗，还给我买鸡肉三明治？

lines.en: : Is that a thing a selfish person would do?
lines.zh: : 自私的人会做这种事吗？

lines.en: : It’s definitely not a thing I would normally do.
lines.zh: : 这绝对不是我平时会做的事。

lines.en: : I just have a bit of a soft spot for you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我想，我只是对你有点心软。

lines.en: : Can you tell me where the spot is so I do not accidentally touch it?
lines.zh: : 你能告诉我那个软点在什么地方吗？这样我就不会不小心碰到它了。

lines.en: : There is one part of me that the coated juice people say I can not let anyone touch no matter what.
lines.zh: : 我身上有一个地方，那些穿着外套的汁液人说，无论如何都不能让别人碰。

lines.en: : I do not want your insides to turn to mush.
lines.zh: : 我可不想让你的内脏变成糊糊。

lines.en: : It’s a phrase. It means that I give you special treatment.
lines.zh: : 那是个说法。意思是我会给你特别的对待。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney9
: Yes! That is what friendship is!
lines.zh: : 对！这就是友情！

lines.en: : We give each other special treatment and help each other defeat sadness clouds!
lines.zh: : 我们给彼此特别的对待，帮彼此打败悲伤云！

lines.en: : Since you made my clouds go away, I, too, will destroy the BZZZ BZZZ inside of you.
lines.zh: : 既然你让我的云消失了，那我也要把你体内的 BZZZ BZZZ 消灭掉。

lines.en: : And what if the “BZZZ BZZZ” comes back tomorrow when you’re not around?
lines.zh: : 要是明天你不在身边的时候，「BZZZ BZZZ」又回来了怎么办？

lines.en: : Are you going to quit work and become my personal the[rapist] or something?
lines.zh: : 你打算辞职，专门来当我的私人 the[rapist]什么的吗？

lines.en: : Do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will bring its own worries. Today’s trouble is enough for today.
lines.zh: : 不要为明天忧虑，因为明天自有明天的忧虑。今天的难处，今天受就够了。

lines.en: : You’re so fucking weird, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 你他妈真的好奇怪，Kaori。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney10
scene kaorijourney11
scene black
Kaori and I have to walk for what I believe is another hour until we finally make it to her apartment.
lines.zh: 我和 Kaori 又走了大概一个小时，才终于到了她的公寓。

lines.en: She remains insistent on “cheering me up” the entire way back but, to be completely honest, I feel exactly the same as I always do.
lines.zh: 一路回来，她都执意要「让我开心起来」，不过说实话，我的感觉和平时一模一样。

lines.en: I imagine she just feels indebted to me after spending the day with her and using roughly half of it to push her over the hill that is death-
lines.zh: 我想，她只是觉得欠了我人情——毕竟这一天我陪着她，还花了差不多一半的时间，推着她翻过那座名叫死亡的山坡——

lines.en: But inviting me back to her place alone is more than enough to repay that debt.
lines.zh: 不过光是把我请回她家，就已经足够还清这份人情了。

lines.en: I’m just hoping she may have heard a little more about what normally happens after inviting someone in, though.
lines.zh: 我只是希望，她对「把人请进门之后通常会发生什么」能多了解那么一点点。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney12
: This is the building that I go to sleep in!
lines.zh: : 这就是我睡觉的那栋楼！

lines.en: : I would first like to show you the door.
lines.zh: : 我想先给你看看门。

lines.en: : Please look at the door.
lines.zh: : 请看这扇门。

lines.en: : Okay...done.
lines.zh: : 好……看完了。

lines.en: : This concludes the outside portion of the tour!
lines.zh: : 参观的室外部分到此结束！

lines.en: : I will now show you the inside of the sleep building.
lines.zh: : 接下来，我要带你看看睡觉楼的里面。

lines.en: : Please follow me, Friend-Burger-Sad-Burger-Chan-Burger.
lines.zh: : 请跟我来，朋友-堡-伤心-堡-chan-堡。

lines.en: scene black
: You added “burger” way too many times. You’re just messing with me at this point...
lines.zh: : 你加了太多次「堡」了。到这一步，你纯属是在逗我玩吧……

lines.en: scene kaorijourney13
I set foot inside of the “sleep building” and am immediately greeted by a rather small one bedroom flat with a half kitchen also serving as the entryway.
lines.zh: 我一脚踏进这栋「睡觉楼」，迎面就是一间相当小的单间公寓，半个厨房还兼作玄关。

lines.en: And, of course, Kaori’s best friend is there to say hello.
lines.zh: 当然，Kaori 最好的朋友也在那儿打招呼。

lines.en: : BACAWK! (Ayo whaaaaaat? Man the fuck you doin’ walkin’ up in here like this?)
lines.zh: : BACAWK！（哟，啥——？哥们你他妈这么走进来是想干嘛？）

lines.en: : Hey, John. Long time, no see.
lines.zh: : 嘿，John。好久不见。

lines.en: : BACAWK! (Yo take yo’ god damn shoes off, man. The hell you thinkin’?)
lines.zh: : BACAWK！（喂，把你那该死的鞋脱了，哥们。你脑子在想啥呢？）

lines.en: : Oh. Sorry about that.
lines.zh: : 哦。抱歉。

lines.en: I kick my shoes off behind me as Kaori makes her way into the living room slash bedroom as well.
lines.zh: 我把鞋踢在身后，Kaori 也已经走进了那间既是客厅又是卧室的房间。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney14
: Friend, why do you remove your foot protectors?
lines.zh: : 朋友，你为什么要脱掉你的脚部保护器？

lines.en: : Because...that’s the polite thing to do.
lines.zh: : 因为……这样比较礼貌。

lines.en: : Do you intend to stay very long?
lines.zh: : 你打算待很久吗？

lines.en: : Are we...going somewhere else or something?
lines.zh: : 我们……还要去别的地方什么的吗？

lines.en: : No. But now that you have seen my apartment, does this not mean that the final out has been hung and that the day is complete?
lines.zh: : 不是。不过既然你已经看过我的公寓了，这不就说明最后的「出去玩」已经挂好、这一天也圆满了吗？

lines.en: : Did you think inviting me in just meant showing me where you lived and then...nothing else?
lines.zh: : 你以为把我请进来，就只是让我看看你住在哪儿，然后……没别的了？

lines.en: : BACAWK (Oof. That’s rough, man.)
lines.zh: : BACAWK！（哎哟。这可太惨了，哥们。）

lines.en: : Stay out of this, John.
lines.zh: : 你别插嘴，John。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney15
: I have never had another human in my room before. I do not know the rules.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有带别的人类进过我的房间。我不懂规矩。

lines.en: : There aren’t really “rules.” I just figured I’d at least get to stay in here and talk for a while longer or something.
lines.zh: : 其实也没什么「规矩」。我只是以为，至少还能在这儿多待一会儿、再聊上一阵什么的。

lines.en: : But I must take off all of my clothing and lay in the water for at least an hour before I close my eyes and go into the sleep!
lines.zh: : 可是我必须先把衣服全脱掉，在水里躺上至少一个小时，然后才能闭上眼睛进入睡眠！

lines.en: : Can I watch?
lines.zh: : 我能看吗？

lines.en: scene kaorijourney16
John doesn’t say anything but I know he’s judging me.
lines.zh: John 什么都没说，但我知道他在鄙视我。

lines.en: : Wh-wh-wh-wh-wh-wh-wh...
lines.zh: : 我、我、我、我、我、我、我……

lines.en: scene kaorijourney17
: WHPSHHHHH!!!!
lines.zh: : WHPSHHHHH！！！！

lines.en: : Was that Latin for “Get out?”
lines.zh: : 那在拉丁语里是「滚出去」的意思吗？

lines.en: : Mhm!
: I’m sorry, Friend, but I unprepared my body to make room for more energy on the way home from Strawberry World!
lines.zh: : 对不起，朋友，可是我在从草莓世界回来的路上，把身体取消了准备，好腾出空间装更多的能量！

lines.en: : That is absolutely not the name of the maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 那绝对不是那家女仆咖啡厅的名字。

lines.en: Actually...what is the name of the maid cafe?
lines.zh: 话说回来……那家女仆咖啡厅到底叫什么名字来着？

lines.en: scene kaorijourney18
: I apologize for not properly understanding this time-honored tradition.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉，我没能正确理解这项历史悠久的传统。

lines.en: : But I...do not want to show you the things that you want to see just yet...
lines.zh: : 可是我……还不想给你看你想看的那些东西……

lines.en: : Will rubbing the co- Will rubbing John make you feel any better?
lines.zh: : 揉揉公——揉揉 John 会让你好受一点吗？

lines.en: : BACAWK! (I’m game if you are, man.)
lines.zh: : BACAWK！（你要是愿意，我也行，哥们。）

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Actually...I’ll just head out. My place isn’t all that far from here anyway.
lines.zh: : 算了……我还是走吧。我家离这儿反正也不算远。

lines.en: : Despite the ending and my horrible mistake, I was happy to spend so much time with you today, Friend.
lines.zh: : 尽管结局是这样，我还犯了个可怕的错误，但今天能和你待这么久，我很开心，朋友。

lines.en: : I hope your clouds are gone.
lines.zh: : 我希望你的云都散了。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: They’re gone.
lines.zh: : 它们散了。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Kaori。

lines.en: scene kaorijourney19
: Bestnight, Friend. It is better than good.
lines.zh: : Bestnight，朋友。它比 Goodnight 更好。

lines.en: : Sure...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Bestnight it is, then.
lines.zh: : 那就 Bestnight 吧。

lines.en: scene black
I exit Kaori’s apartment and find myself arriving back at my porch in no time at all.
lines.zh: 我走出 Kaori 的公寓，没多久就回到了自家的门廊。

lines.en: I don’t want to say that today was smooth sailing the whole way through or anything like that.
lines.zh: 我可不想说今天全程都是一帆风顺之类的话。

lines.en: In fact, the water was pretty harsh all day long.
lines.zh: 事实上，今天一整天的水面都相当凶险。

lines.en: But, some way or another, we managed to avoid crashing into any rogue waves and came out with a bond much stronger than before.
lines.zh: 不过，不管怎么说，我们还是避开了那些失控的浪头，出来时的羁绊也比从前牢固得多。

lines.en: I mean, I know where Kaori lives now.
lines.zh: 我是说，我现在知道 Kaori 住在哪儿了。

lines.en: And it looked exceedingly normal apart from the giant chicken, so that in itself was a huge surprise.
lines.zh: 而且除了那只巨大的鸡之外，那地方看起来异常正常，光是这一点就已经是个巨大的惊喜了。

lines.en: I just hope that I can actually spend more than thirty seconds in there some day.
lines.zh: 我只希望有朝一日，我能在里面待上超过三十秒。

lines.en: For now, though...it makes sense.
lines.zh: 不过现在这样……也说得通。

lines.en: She might not make sense, but the situation does.
lines.zh: 她这个人可能说不通，但这件事说得通。

lines.en: And I should probably learn a little more about her before I expect her to start “properly upholding any time honored traditions” with me...
lines.zh: 也许我该再多了解她一点，再去指望她开始和我「好好履行那些历史悠久的传统」……

$ kaoridate15p3 = True
Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!
lines.zh: Kaori 的好感度提升到了 [kaori_love]!
